subject: Pipeline preservation sprint — decision request for lingering opportunities
messages:
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@clearlinehealth.com>
Cc: procurement@clearlinehealth.com
Date: Sat, 12 Jul 2025 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Pipeline preservation sprint — decision request for lingering opportunities

Team,

Finance ran a light hygiene pass on the Q3 commit bucket and flagged a handful of opportunities that look aged (no activity in 45+ days) and have inconsistent Stage / Close Date values in SFDC. We need a quick decision: requalify with evidence, adjust stage/close date, or move to "Shelved/Dead" so the forecast reflects reality.

I attached a short snapshot (Q3_pipeline_snapshot.csv) with 7 rows: Opportunity, AE, current Stage, Close Date in SFDC, last activity, and a suggested action column. Please do the following by EOD Tuesday (48 business hours):
- For each opp you own: update Stage to the correct value and set a realistic Close Date OR mark the record as Shelved.
- If requalifying, add one-line proof in the Opportunity description (meeting scheduled, PO request, legal review started, etc.).
- If you need a short requalification call with the buyer, reply-all with up to 2 preferred times.

Top three to act on (from the snapshot):
1) CLH-54819 — ClearLine pilot expansion — AE: Vanessa Ortiz — SF Close Date: 2025-07-28 — Last activity: 2025-05-01
2) CLH-55201 — Integration services — AE: Marcus Lin — SF Close Date: 2025-08-15 — Last activity: 2025-03-18
3) CLH-56333 — Eval + Procurement — AE: Monica Patel — SF Close Date: 2025-07-30 — Last activity: 2025-04-22

Why this matters: Finance will exclude unvalidated deals from the committed forecast in three days unless there is explicit evidence or an updated close timeline. If a deal is strategic and needs special handling, note that in-line and I'll escalate for an exception.

Attachments: Q3_pipeline_snapshot.csv (CSV); requalification_notes_template.docx (short copy you can paste into SFDC)

Thanks — short and concrete please.

David
David Kim
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

- Move Close Date to 2025-08-15 (buyer requested extra procurement window)

A couple of notes from our side that should help the requalification entry:
- We expect a pilot extension to be within existing scope; PO to follow contingent on SOW language.
- Our procurement team requested a 30-day billing hold for the pilot (they cited internal budget windows).

I'll be on the call and will reply with any follow-up items after we sync.

Thanks all — quick recap and next steps (so Finance has a single source of truth):
- CLH-54819 (Vanessa): Stage set to Negotiation, Close Date updated to 2025-08-15, proof pasted in description per Vanessa's note.
- CLH-55201 (Marcus): Marcus, please confirm by EOD Wednesday whether you want us to move to Shelved or provide requalifying evidence; I'll mark it at-risk in the forecast otherwise.
- CLH-56333 (Monica): Monica, you flagged an outstanding technical eval. Please add the eval scheduling note and expected decision week (or move to Shelved).

Records to adjust in SFDC now: https://redwood.salesforce.com/Opportunity/00Q5g00000CxYzE (CLH-54819) — David will follow up with Finance after Tuesday's call to request exception if procurement timeline pushes commit.

If any AE needs Finance to hold a one-off exception for forecast inclusion, paste the business reason in the opp description and add me as a follower; I'll escalate.

Thanks for quick turn on this.

David
